description: Part single part 2-storey side/rear extension involving creation of garage space and rear dormer.
decision_conditions: The proposed first floor side extension, by virtue of its siting, scale and design, would result in the loss of the original catslide roof, a defining feature of the host dwelling. Its removal would materially alter the proportions and roof profile of the building and would disrupt the symmetry of the semi-detached pair, particularly as the adjoining property retains this feature. The proposal would therefore create a visually unbalanced and incongruous form that fails to preserve the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the surrounding area. The development is contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policies D3 and D5 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD13, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
